about_the_game:
Martial Law: Our Spring Demo is a free playable demo of the upcoming 2D pixel art adventure game and gives you a chance to experience the first 30 minutes of gameplay.

Step into the shoes of Stanisław, an ordinary man trying to survive everyday life under martial law. This short demo introduces new mechanics, storytelling direction, and a fresh top-down perspective that changes how you explore the world.

This demo includes:
  • Around 30 minutes of story-driven gameplay
  • A new top-down camera view for exploration
  • More interactive environments and characters
  • A glimpse of the new, expanded map
  • First look at updated dialogue and choice systems

This is just the beginning – but it’s enough to show where Martial Law is headed next.
